args.title: Fix amount parsing issue in toTransaction function
args.body:
File: src/ingest/schema.ts

Update the parseAmount function to handle currency symbols correctly, preventing null returns for amounts like '₹1,250.00'.

label: bug
file: src/ingest/schema.ts
This comment was written by RepoMind, an automated triage agent. To reach a person, mention @ledgerline/maintainers.

The function 'toTransaction' in 'src/ingest/schema.ts' checks the amount using 'parseAmount', which returns null for amounts with currency symbols like '₹1,250.00', leading to the error 'The amount is not a number'.
